The package group prefix com.github.* is not GitHub Enterprise Server. These suppress incorrect GitHub Enterprise Server matches reported against M-Lab ndt7 and Compose Stability runtime Maven artifacts.

Dependency-Check incorrectly maps Kotlin CVE-2026-53914 to the kotlin-stdlib 2.4.10 runtime artifact through a generic JetBrains Kotlin CPE. The advisory affects unsafe build-cache metadata deserialization in kotlin-gradle-plugin, not kotlin-stdlib. The build-tool finding is reviewed separately by the OSV exception, and Gradle and Kotlin build caches are disabled in gradle.properties. Revisit when stable Kotlin 2.4.20 or newer is available.
